source_note: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则
english_source_note: Liouville Principles for Holomorphic and Meromorphic Functions
callout_id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#6
statement_en: Let \(f\) be entire, and let $$u(z)=\\operatorname{Re}(f(z))$$ be its real part. Suppose that on every circle \(C_r(0)\) one has the upper bound $$u(z)\\leq Cr^s,\\quad s\\geq 0.$$ Prove that \(f\) is a polynomial of degree at most \(s\).
key_techniques: harmonic estimates for the real part
Cauchy estimates via bounds on real part
polynomial growth criterion for entire functions
callout_body: $f$是整函数$u(z) = \text{Re}(f)$是其实部,并且对于任意圆周$C_r(0)$上都有上界估计$$u(z)\leq Cr^s,s\geq 0$$那么整函数$f$是一个至多不超过$s$次的多项式。
